properties.statement: Broadcast with one operand calls the scalar function on each selected cell.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ {β ε : Type} (apply : β → Except ε β) (err : ε) (data : Esm.Expr.ArrayData β), Esm.Expr.ArrayData.broadcast (fun | [x] => apply x | _ => throw err) err [data] = (do let cells ← (Esm.Expr.ArrayData.coords data.dims).mapM (fun ix => match data.broadcastAt ix with | some x => apply x | none => throw err); return ⟨data.dims, cells⟩)
